description: This Java class, ThingModelJsonExamplesProducer, is a utility for generating example JSON files representing model data and authorization contexts for Eclipse Ditto. It creates various JSON structures such as Thing objects, attributes, features, and access control lists, and writes them to files.

classes.name: ThingModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A final class containing the main method to produce example JSON data files for testing or demonstration purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application; processes command-line arguments and initiates JSON production.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates directories and initiates the generation of authorization context JSON files.

methods.name: produceThingModel
methods.description: Generates various JSON files including things, features, attributes, and access control lists.

methods.name: createAttributeExampleJsonObject
methods.description: Creates and returns a JSON object attribute with predefined key-value pairs.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to JSON and writes it to the specified file.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a raw JSON string to the specified file, printing the file path to the console.
